# Welcome to Omarchy!

Omarchy is an omakase Linux distribution based on Arch, Hyprland, and Quickshell.

## Navigating

Super + Space opens the Omarchy menu.

| Key | Function |
| --- | -------- |
| `Super + Space` | Omarchy menu |

## The top bar

The bar shows workspaces, windows, and the clock.

### Bar modules

Modules can be added or removed via the menu.

## Themes

Themes are applied with `omarchy theme set <name>`.

```sh
omarchy theme list
```
